q1_skip_lift_readiness.verdict_per_row: Every one of the 21 F1 skip rows requires at least one boolean whose carrier pair is swept-carrier x swept-carrier or swept-carrier x canonical (revolved/lofted/spline carriers). PY_BRIDGE_COMPAT_SURFACE.md S1 (line 51) records canonical x canonical as landed and sweep x canonical / sweep x sweep as deferred-bie resolved by BIE-006; SKIPS.json's reason rows still resolve to BIE-006 (not yet removed), and no landed swept-pair boolean symbol path is demonstrable from the allowed reads (the kernel boolean_op/SSI4/CL-004 machinery lives under vendor/truck, outside read_allow). Therefore none of the 21 is classified lift-candidate on this evidence; each is classified missing-kernel naming the absent landed swept-carrier boolean path. The canonical-x-canonical-only booleans that DO have a landed S1 path (e.g. drivetrain gear/disc bores drivetrain.py:750-753) do not by themselves unskip any row because every enclosing row also fuses/cuts swept carriers.
